headline: Malaysia, Singapore state investors dismiss Indonesia stock selloff, cite their long-term commitment
summary: State investors from Malaysia and Singapore said they are committed to investing in Indonesia for the long term, dismissing a stock selloff that followed an action by index provider MSCI.
why: MSCI is a major index provider whose benchmarks are tracked by many global funds, so its decisions on a country can trigger passive buying or selling in its stocks.
why_moved: The input describes a stock selloff in Indonesia following an MSCI action. Index provider decisions can prompt funds that track MSCI benchmarks to sell holdings.
